hero.title: Owner-operated technology work with disciplined fundamentals.
hero.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works is a small technology consultancy based in South Carolina's Lowcountry, focused on useful websites, business systems, automation, digital ownership, and practical technical problem-solving.

founder.name: Eddie Gugino
founder.title: Practical delivery shaped by IT, cybersecurity, systems, and technical operations.
founder.body: Eddie started Lowcountry Digital Works to help smaller organizations improve websites, workflows, and technical systems without forcing enterprise-sized complexity onto ordinary business problems. His background spans IT, cybersecurity, systems, and technical delivery, including service in the U.S. Navy. The operating model is intentionally direct: understand the problem first, use established tools where they fit, build only where a real gap remains, treat security, access, and recovery as ordinary delivery quality, and leave ownership and handoff understandable.
founder.credentials: Eddie holds the CISSP certification, a bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity from Utica College, and an Associate of Applied Science (AAS) in Network Systems Management from Midlands Technical College in Columbia, South Carolina.
founder.note: Founder photo remains pending owner selection before production.

principles.title: Lowcountry roots
principles.description: Local context matters, but the work is not restricted to one geography.

principles.title: Clear ownership
principles.description: Critical business assets should be held in the right owner accounts with named access, documented handoff, and a practical recovery path.

principles.title: Technology in proportion
principles.description: Native features, simple architectures, and maintained services are preferred when they solve the problem well. More infrastructure is added only when a real requirement justifies it.

principles.title: Work that can be explained
principles.description: Documentation, testing, security, accessibility, and understandable tradeoffs are treated as part of normal delivery quality.

whySmall.title: Small by design does not mean casual about delivery.
whySmall.body: LDW is intentionally lean. That means avoiding invented scale, unnecessary subscriptions, and systems that exist mainly to make the provider harder to replace.
items: Direct communication with the person responsible for the work
Documented decisions instead of hidden knowledge
A clear path for handoff, maintenance, recovery, or future growth

fit.title: Organizations with a concrete digital problem and a preference for understandable systems.
fit.body: Good engagements begin with a real need: a website that is not doing its job, repetitive work that should be automated, fragmented tools, unclear ownership, or a technical decision that needs an independent practical plan.
